howto.goal: Write a small strategy card and send it into a turn-based fight on the hex board. The card with the better priorities gives you the better moves.
howto.setup: You write a card of eight weighted priorities: what to attack, what to defend, when to push. Then you fight a house card on the hex board.

sections.title: The card
sections.text: A card is a short list of weighted priorities. Higher weights win arguments when the bot has to choose.

sections.title: The fight
sections.text: The battle runs turn by turn on a hex board. You click a highlighted hex to move your units; the card sets their priorities.

sections.title: Improving
sections.text: After a fight, change one weight at a time. A card that wins moves up the ladder.

controls: Press Play a battle to fight with your saved card.
Edit the card in Card JSON and press Save card, or press Improve my bot to ask your model for a better one.
Use Restart and Step to replay the fight move by move.

frames.say: The card decides where they push.

demo.intro: A fight between two cards, in four beats.

frames.say: Two players each write a weighted card of priorities.
The fight starts on the hex board.
Each turn the cards decide movement, so the fight plays itself.
One side breaks through and the fight ends.

demo.outro: Change one weight at a time and fight again — that is how a card gets better.

steps.say: Read the priorities on your card before you change anything.
Change the weights in Card JSON and press Save card, or press Improve my bot.
Press Play a battle to fight, then use Step to see what your card actually did.
Change one weight at a time, or you will not know what helped.
